title: Yesterday
description: Talk about what you did yesterday using the Past Simple.

introduction.headline: Talk about yesterday
introduction.body: You will learn how to describe past activities and use time expressions like yesterday and last week.
introduction.bodyIt: Imparerai a descrivere attività passate e a usare espressioni come yesterday e last week.
objectives: Use the Past Simple for finished actions
Read a short text about a past day

vocabulary.example: I went to the shop yesterday.

options: I went to the shop yesterday.
I go to the shop yesterday.
I going to the shop yesterday.
I goes to the shop yesterday.
exercises.answer: I went to the shop yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Use Past Simple (went) for finished actions in the past.
The Past Simple of buy is bought.

review.tip: Tell someone three things you did yesterday using went or bought.
